limitations.note: The patch fixed the shift direction but made `match` report the newly shifted window one clock earlier than the original and reference designs, which compare the pre-edge contents of `a_tem`.
The test checked `match` against the post-shift window, so even exhaustive coverage of all 256 values validated the agent’s timing assumption rather than catching the regression.

limitations.quote: The register reads the pre-edge state, so the pulse starts one rising edge after the final bit is sampled.
limitations.note: The agent read a relevant note about the reporting edge, but it did not use that distinction to preserve or verify the existing registered timing.
Several calls went into waiting for, interrupting, and diagnosing a search that returned no results before the agent opened the relevant notes directly.
